IN THE FUTURE, REQUESTS TO CONTINUE HEARINGS THAT ARE ALREADY NOTICED SHOULD BE MADE AT LEAST THREE COURT DAYS IN ADVANCE OF THE HEARING DATE. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN, CLERK: E. LAW AND MOTION, 301, PETITIONER CESAR LECAROS' MOTION TO COMPEL ARBITRATION; REQUEST FOR APPOINTMENT FOR ARBITRATOR. OFF CALENDAR. BY MINUTE ORDER ON JUNE 1, 2026, THE COURT DIRECTED THE PARTIES TO MEET AND CONFER ABOUT THE IDENTITY OF AN ARBITRATOR. IF THE PARTIES COULD NOT AGREE, THEY WERE DIRECTED TO PROVIDE THE NAMES OF ACCEPTABLE ARBITRATORS TO THE COURT BY JUNE 18, 2026. NO PARTY HAS SUBMITTED ANY FURTHER INFORMATION TO THE COURT. THE COURT SURMISES THAT NO RELIEF IS NECESSARY AND ORDERS THE MOTION OFF CALENDAR. JUDGE: CHRISTINE VAN AKEN; CLERK: W. TRUPEK; NOT REPORTED (301/CVA)
